I've been an Acme Fibre customer for over three years on the 200 Mbps plan. It's been really frustrating, especially since I work from home. Could you check what's going on with my line, and let me know what Acme can do for me as a long-time customer for all this downtime?

Thanks,
Rohit Sharma
(Account: 88xxxx2143)

row.reply:
Hello Rohit,

Thank you for writing to us, and I'm sorry to hear about the drops you've been facing in the evenings.

Before I can look into your line, I need to flag one thing: the name and account details in your email don't match our records. For your security, we can only discuss account details with the account holder named on the account. Please write to us from the email address or phone number registered on the account, or call our support helpline so our team can verify the details with you.

Please note that evening Wi-Fi speeds can drop when many devices are connected at once. You can also test your speed on a cable connection at fast.com.

A customer representative will follow up with you to confirm the account details. Thank you for your patience, and we're sorry for the inconvenience.

Best regards,
Acme Fibre Support

As promised, a customer representative will call you about your case, and they can go through anything specific to your account with you then.

Warm regards,
Acme Fibre Support

result.title: Slow speed or no internet: first checks
result.text: If the internet is slow, or down with no outage on record in the customer's area, ask the customer to restart the router (switch it off for 30 seconds) and check that the cables are firmly plugged in. For slow speed, then test the speed on a cable connection at fast.com. For Wi-Fi, move closer to the router. Evening speeds on Wi-Fi can be lower when many devices are connected.

result.title: Technician visits
result.text: If the speed on a cable connection is below half of the plan speed after a restart, book a technician visit. If the internet is still down after a restart and there is no outage in the area, offer one: the customer replies and a visit is booked. Visits are free and happen within 2 working days.
